attempts.thought: This team is built around a strong offensive core with good defensive synergy for best-of-3 pick battles. Gholdengo and Kingambit provide Steel-type pressure and priority, Dragonite and Garchomp offer versatile physical attackers, Rotom-Wash is a bulky pivot, and Skeledirge gives a win condition with Torch Song plus Unaware to stop setup sweepers.

The sets follow the plan: Gholdengo is a fast special breaker with Nasty Plot, Dragonite is a Dragon Dance sweeper behind Multiscale, and Garchomp is a Focus Sash lead that sets Stealth Rock and hits hard. Rotom-Wash pivots with Volt Switch and spreads burns, Kingambit is the late-game cleaner with Swords Dance and Sucker Punch boosted by Supreme Overlord, and Skeledirge is the Unaware win condition that stalls setup sweepers while boosting with Torch Song.

notes.item: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.
notes.ability: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon lose 1/8 of their max HP.

moves.Earthquake: Ground · Physical · power 100 · 100% accuracy. Hits adjacent Pokemon. Double damage on Dig.
moves.Dragon Claw: Dragon · Physical · power 80 · 100% accuracy. No additional effect.
moves.Crunch: Dark · Physical · power 80 · 100% accuracy. 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.
moves.Fire Fang: Fire · Physical · power 65 · 95% accuracy. 10% chance to burn. 10% chance to flinch.

notes.item: If held by a Scizor, this item allows it to Mega Evolve in battle.
notes.ability: This Pokemon's moves of 60 power or less have 1.5x power, including Struggle.

moves.U-turn: Bug · Physical · power 70 · 100% accuracy. User switches out after damaging the target.
moves.Bullet Punch: Steel · Physical · power 40 · 100% accuracy · priority +1. Usually goes first.
moves.Superpower: Fighting · Physical · power 120 · 100% accuracy. Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1.
moves.Swords Dance: Normal · Status · 100% accuracy. Raises the user's Attack by 2.

notes.item: Holder's special attacks have 1.1x power.
notes.ability: This Pokemon is immune to Ground; Gravity/Ingrain/Smack Down/Iron Ball nullify it.

moves.Volt Switch: Electric · Special · power 70 · 100% accuracy. User switches out after damaging the target.
moves.Hydro Pump: Water · Special · power 110 · 80% accuracy. No additional effect.
moves.Will-O-Wisp: Fire · Status · 85% accuracy. Burns the target.
moves.Pain Split: Normal · Status · 100% accuracy. Shares HP of user and target equally.

notes.item: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.
notes.ability: This Pokemon's Status moves have priority raised by 1, but Dark types are immune.

moves.Dazzling Gleam: Fairy · Special · power 80 · 100% accuracy. No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.
moves.Flash Cannon: Steel · Special · power 80 · 100% accuracy. 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.
moves.Magic Room: Psychic · Status · 100% accuracy. For 5 turns, all held items have no effect.
moves.Spikes: Ground · Status · 100% accuracy. Hurts grounded foes on switch-in. Max 3 layers.

notes.item: Holder's Speed is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.
notes.ability: This Pokemon's type changes to the type of the move it is using. Once per switch-in.

moves.Water Shuriken: Water · Special · power 15 · 100% accuracy · priority +1. Usually goes first. Hits 2-5 times in one turn.
moves.Ice Beam: Ice · Special · power 90 · 100% accuracy. 10% chance to freeze the target.
moves.U-turn: Bug · Physical · power 70 · 100% accuracy. User switches out after damaging the target.
moves.Substitute: Normal · Status · 100% accuracy. User takes 1/4 its max HP to put in a substitute.

notes.item: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.
notes.ability: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled; immunity to Sandstorm.

moves.Earthquake: Ground · Physical · power 100 · 100% accuracy. Hits adjacent Pokemon. Double damage on Dig.
moves.Iron Head: Steel · Physical · power 80 · 100% accuracy. 20% chance to make the target flinch.
moves.Swords Dance: Normal · Status · 100% accuracy. Raises the user's Attack by 2.
moves.Stealth Rock: Rock · Status · 100% accuracy. Hurts foes on switch-in. Factors Rock weakness.

attempts.thought: I'm building a balanced offensive team with strong type coverage and synergy. Garchomp and Excadrill provide Ground-type attacks and physical power, Scizor offers priority support and Steel-type defense, Rotom-Wash gives special attacking and pivoting, Klefki adds Fairy/Steel bulk, and Greninja brings speed and water coverage. This core handles most common threats while maintaining enough versatility for the BSS rating bracket.
